description: This file manages system run approval logic, including validation, approval decision enforcement, and interaction with approval records within a gateway context.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a record if it is an object, null otherwise.

methods.name: normalizeString
methods.description: Trims and normalizes an unknown value to a string or null.

methods.name: normalizeApprovalDecision
methods.description: Normalizes approval decision strings to 'allow-once' or 'allow-always'.

methods.name: clientHasApprovals
methods.description: Checks if the client has approval scopes.

methods.name: pickSystemRunParams
methods.description: Selectively copies allowed system run parameters from raw input.
